paragraphs: Bandwango sells mobile passes that let a destination showcase its local restaurants, breweries and attractions while tracking visitor interactions. The pitch to tourism organizations is an easier way to measure economic impact.

Staff start from one of the pass templates and customize it to their needs and brand. They then add local places to go, discounts and admissions, with Bandwango helping onboard each business added. Passes work via any browser and save to a phone home screen, so passholders do not download extra apps. Arrival at a location is verified by GPS and merchant verified check-in. Organizations can add rewards to a pass and set a point goal for each one. The product is described as fully white labeled, down to fonts, colors, imagery and logos.

The home page claims over 500 clients. It also claims more than 40,000 local businesses. Paid passes can be featured and resold through a third party network of resellers and distributors. The company says it is an approved connectivity partner, so its passes can appear directly in search results.

quote.text: Passes work anywhere the adventure takes you.
